E1_post_hoc_students._note: EXPLORATORY, added after seeing outcomes. The four students share the base pool of 2,626 distillation targets (31 whitelisted train sequences); S-PT-mined / -rand / -rand2 are post hoc variants of S-PT. They are NOT independent evidence: the pairwise Spearman between their D vectors is reported, and 'pooled' only reduces seed noise, not the n = 25 limit.

E2_gain_over_Edinburgh_student._note: EXPLORATORY, added after seeing outcomes. S-Edi = the Edinburgh-pig student (no PigTrack targets in its distillation). A coverage effect would show as a larger S-PT minus S-Edi gain where PigTrack training covered the view. Descriptive; registered contrast C6 is S-PT - S-Edi on the whole test set.

E3_difficulty_context.note: EXPLORATORY, added after seeing outcomes. Does the shortfall just follow how hard the sequence is for SAM 3, and does coverage track the teacher's own HOTA?

E4_official_val_descriptive._note: EXPLORATORY, added after seeing outcomes; plan section 8.4 pre-specifies no val analysis. Val has no SAM 3 / SAM 2.1 arm, so no shortfall can be computed; HOTA by tier mixes scene difficulty with coverage.

E6_leave_one_sequence_out.note: EXPLORATORY, added after seeing outcomes: leave-one-sequence-out rho(S, D_PT); 0067 and 0049 are the extremes the controller already knew.

E7_gain_pattern_dependence_checks._note: EXPLORATORY, added after seeing outcomes. Checks whether the E2 pattern survives pen clustering, leave-one-pen-out and the A4 covariates. Val and test come from the same 9 pens; 'pooled' treats the 45 as one sample. Post hoc, no multiplicity correction.
